description: This file defines a Flutter widget named ReviewCard that displays a review summary, including rating, number of reviews, and a breakdown of star ratings. It also includes a RateBar sub-widget for visualizing the proportion of each star rating.

classes.name: ReviewCard
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a review summary with overall rating, total reviews, and per-star rating distribution.

classes.name: RateBar
classes.description: A stateless widget that visualizes the proportion of a specific star rating using a linear progress bar.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the ReviewCard or RateBar widget.
